source_note: Curated 2026-07-19 for PS-liquidity-redesign-0.1 (ratified): diagnostic of the U.S. bank liquidity regime vs fast-moving runs — DW/FHLB collateral+operational fragmentation, discount-window stigma sources, reporting timing/granularity connection (narrow), and the Hsu/McKernan proposal-mapping layer. NO pre-existing census (contrast AML): completeness class curated_set throughout; see GAP-L5. Snapshot: DL-002-style pin at acquisition time. Boundaries per PS: LCR/NSFR, deposit insurance/resolution, full reporting corpus.

items.title: Federal Reserve Act s.10B — Advances to individual member banks
items.note: Discount-window advances authority; incl. FDICIA limits on advances to undercapitalized banks — a structural stigma/access vector

items.title: Federal Reserve Act s.13(3) — Emergency lending
items.note: COORDINATION: emergency facilities frame the LOLR boundary around the ordinary discount window; Dodd-Frank amendments

items.title: Federal Home Loan Bank Act s.10 — Advances to members; collateral
items.note: FHLB advances + eligible-collateral categories — the statutory half of the DW/FHLB collateral fragmentation

items.title: Dodd-Frank Act ss.1101-1103 — emergency lending reforms and delayed disclosure of borrowers
items.note: Statutory disclosure regime for DW/emergency borrowing — a named structural source of stigma

items.title: Discount Window modernization legislation (Warner-Kennedy)
items.note: HORIZON: pending bill; never anchors a current-law claim; belongs on the proposal-mapping table

items.title: Regulation A — Extensions of Credit by Federal Reserve Banks
items.note: Primary/secondary/seasonal credit terms, collateral, rates — the DW's operative regulation

items.title: FHFA Advances regulation
items.note: FHLBank advances: authorized purposes, collateral, terms — the FHLB half of the operational seam

items.title: FR 2052a — Complex Institution Liquidity Monitoring Report
items.note: SCOPE LIMIT: in scope only for the timing/granularity-vs-fast-runs connection, not as a reporting-corpus refactor

items.title: Call Report (FFIEC 031/041/051) — liquidity-relevant schedules and filing cadence
items.note: SCOPE LIMIT: quarterly cadence vs hours-scale runs is the diagnostic point; schedules cited, corpus not distilled

items.title: Interagency Policy Statement on Funding and Liquidity Risk Management (SR 10-6)
items.note: The baseline liquidity-risk-management expectations the 2023 addendum amends

items.title: Addendum: Importance of Contingency Funding Plans (post-SVB; discount-window readiness and testing)
items.note: Urges DW pre-positioning and operational testing — the supervisory answer to stigma; core diagnostic evidence

items.title: OCC Bulletin 2023-25 transmitting the CFP addendum
items.note: Same substance, second instrument — retained deliberately as fragmentation evidence (one addendum, four issuances)

items.title: FDIC FIL-39-2023 transmitting the CFP addendum
items.note: Same substance, third instrument — fragmentation evidence

items.title: Federal Reserve Operating Circulars index (incl. OC-10 Lending: agreements, collateral pledging)
items.note: The legal/operational plumbing of DW borrowing — where 'rapid functionality' succeeds or fails

items.title: Discount Window program terms (primary/secondary/seasonal credit)
items.note: Operative program terms as published to borrowers

items.title: Discount Window / PSR collateral eligibility, valuation, and margins
items.note: The collateral-eligibility half of the DW/FHLB interoperability seam

items.title: FHLBank System at 100: Focusing on the Future (FHFA report)
items.note: FHFA's own account of the FHLB liquidity role vs the Fed's LOLR — primary fragmentation evidence
